content.text: The inbox permissions currently allow access by role without checking the recipient, and “mark all read” ignores the recipient entirely. Alerts and search results also build URLs from IDs, while the app’s routes require workspace and project slugs plus an issue number. I’ll fix those checks and use the served route shapes for links.

Status changes and assignments at creation had no alert handlers, and join alerts were addressed to the new member. I’ve added those handlers and corrected the recipient. Next I’ll connect plan warnings to refused writes and suppress repeats for each resource while its warning remains unread.
